description: Data-driven process-improvement cycle: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control. Anchors process-optimisation engagements in measured baselines and statistically verified root causes.
best_for: Process optimisation with a measurable defect, cycle-time or cost problem
Establishing a KPI baseline before recommending change

steps.name: Define
steps.description: Problem statement, scope, customer (CTQ) requirements and business case.

steps.name: Measure
steps.description: Map the current process and collect baseline data on its performance.

steps.name: Analyze
steps.description: Identify and verify root causes of variation and waste.

steps.name: Improve
steps.description: Generate, evaluate and pilot solutions that address the verified root causes.

steps.name: Control
steps.description: Standardise the improvement and monitor to hold the gains.

pitfalls: Recommending solutions in Analyze before root causes are verified with data
Baselines built from anecdotes rather than measured samples
No Control phase owner — gains erode within two quarters
